title: BMW Motor Sports — Oct 24, 2026
html:
1. IMSA

No races this week; next round: Rolex 24 At Daytona, Daytona International Speedway, Jan 28–31, 2027 (2026 season ended at Petit Le Mans in early October). source

2. WEC

  • 6 Hours of Barcelona — Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya, Oct 18, 2026 (Hypercar) — #15 BMW M Hybrid V8, BMW M Team WRT (Magnussen / Vanthoor / Marciello): P7. #20 Shell BMW M Hybrid V8, BMW M Team WRT (Rast / S. van der Linde / Frijns): P14, 1 lap down after a 20-second penalty. source
  • 6 Hours of Barcelona — LMGT3 — #69 BMW M4 GT3 EVO, Team WRT (Harper / Thompson / McIntosh): P3 — Dan Harper's third LMGT3 podium of the season (per BMW). #32 BMW M4 GT3 EVO, Team WRT (Farfus / Gelael / Leung): P10 per FIA WEC official results (BMW press release says 12th; official value used). source
  • BMW driver line-ups & championship — Driver crews per BMW M Motorsport; BMW retains 2nd in the Hypercar manufacturers' standings after Barcelona. source
  • Next race: 6 Hours of Monza — Autodromo Nazionale Monza, Nov 6–8, 2026 (race Nov 8) — Season finale; replaces the originally planned Qatar/Bahrain rounds. source

3. DTM / BMW M2 Cup

No races this week; 2026 season concluded at Hockenheim (Oct 9–11): Marco Wittmann 3rd in DTM standings, Michael Schrey (Hofor Racing by Bonk Motorsport) inaugural ADAC BMW M2 Cup champion. Next round: 2027 season opener — date not verified. source

4. WorldSBK

  • Prometeon Spanish Round (season finale) — Circuito de Jerez, Race 2, Oct 18, 2026 — ROKiT BMW Motorrad WorldSBK Team: Miguel Oliveira P10; Danilo Petrucci (#9) P20. Winner Nicolò Bulega (Ducati). source
  • Jerez — Race 1 (Oct 17) & Superpole Race (Oct 18) — Per BMW Motorrad: Oliveira DNF (technical) / P11; Petrucci P17 / P19. Not verified on the official WorldSBK results page. source
  • Final 2026 standings (BMW) — Oliveira's Race 2 P10 secured 3rd for BMW in the Manufacturers' Championship (184 pts); Oliveira 11th in riders' standings (142 pts). source

5. FIM EWC

No races this week; 2026 season over (BMW Motorrad World Endurance Team crowned world champions at the Bol d'Or in September). Next round: 24 Heures Motos, Le Mans, Apr 8–11, 2027. source

6. Technical & Driver News

  • Danilo Petrucci leaves BMW / WorldSBK — Jerez was Petrucci's final WorldSBK race; he said BMW "decided they wanted to move in another direction." No BMW replacement officially named in the article. source
  • BMW M Hybrid V8 / M4 GT3 EVO / M2 Racing — No new technical announcements found for Oct 17–24 in BMW M Motorsport press releases. source

Coverage gaps: fimewc.com (site returned errors; 2027 EWC calendar taken from cyclenews.com); dtm.com (requires JavaScript, 2027 DTM dates unverified); worldsbk.com official results pages for Jerez Race 1 / Superpole Race (positions from BMW press release only); Petrucci's Race 2 P20 inferred from worldsbk.com race report; bmw-m.com news (no 2026 items in window found).
